Name: Unofficial Haley and Emily Redraw by Dizor For Content Patcher
Author: JingPing99
Description:
[b]Description
[/b]A content patcher version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/164]Haley's and Emily's Redraws by Dizor[/url].

[b]Notes
[/b]All credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/947745]Dizor[/url].
You can check out the original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/164]here[/url]!

[b]Install
[/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download the mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
